tokens.name: surface-0
tokens.usage: Page background, tab bar, status bar; the PWA manifest and theme-color.

tokens.name: surface-1
tokens.usage: Raised: the ticket card, sheets, toasts, text fields, chart surface.

tokens.name: surface-2
tokens.usage: Sunken fills: segmented track, chips at rest, skeletons, pressed rows, info banner.

tokens.name: ink-1
tokens.usage: Primary text and the hero number, on surface-0/1/2.

tokens.name: ink-2
tokens.usage: Secondary text: city in the header, meta lines, base-currency amount, on surface-0/1/2.

tokens.name: ink-3
tokens.usage: Muted text: departures-board labels, captions, placeholders, tab labels at rest, on surface-0/1/2.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline (1px) between rows and sections, ticket perforation dashes. Decorative only.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Boundaries that must be seen (>=3:1): ticket edge, text-field border, chip outline, unchecked controls.

tokens.name: icon
tokens.usage: Default Lucide icon colour (= ink-2).

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Runway orange. Interaction only: primary button and FAB fill, links, active tab, selected segment/chip. Never a fill on data, never status.

tokens.name: accent-ink
tokens.usage: Label and icon on an accent fill (primary button, FAB).

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Selection wash behind accent text (selected chip, selected segment, pressed link row).

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring: 2px solid, 2px offset in the surface colour.

tokens.name: status-good
tokens.usage: Good: "Saved offline", "Ready to fly". Always with an icon (circle-check) and a word.

tokens.name: status-warning
tokens.usage: Warning: data getting stale, a document not saved offline yet. Icon (triangle-alert) + word.

tokens.name: status-serious
tokens.usage: Serious: a night without lodging, over budget. Icon (octagon-alert) + word. Re-stepped from round 1 to stay clear of the accent.

tokens.name: status-critical
tokens.usage: Critical: failed sync, destructive actions, field errors. Icon (circle-x) + word.

tokens.name: print-warning
tokens.usage: Full-width "Bring this printed" banner fill. The only tinted band in the system.

tokens.name: on-print-warning
tokens.usage: Title, icon and action on print-warning.

tokens.name: on-print-warning-2
tokens.usage: Secondary line on print-warning.

tokens.name: offline
tokens.usage: Connection status "Offline · everything saved": calm, not an alarm (same value as ink-2).

tokens.name: stamp-ink
tokens.usage: Passport stamps on the trip list and empty states only: outline, place name and date. Never on data.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Backdrop behind bottom sheets. No blur.

tokens.name: gridline
tokens.usage: Chart gridlines: 1px solid, horizontal only.

tokens.name: baseline
tokens.usage: Chart baseline / axis rule: 1px solid.

tokens.name: mark-neutral
tokens.usage: Single-series chart marks (spend per category). Charts are ink, never accent.

tokens.name: mark-muted
tokens.usage: De-emphasised marks ("Other", previous period). Sub-3:1, so always labelled.

tokens.name: series-1
tokens.usage: Categorical slot 1 (blue). Charts only, assigned by entity in fixed order.

tokens.name: series-2
tokens.usage: Categorical slot 2 (aqua). Charts only, assigned by entity in fixed order.

tokens.name: series-3
tokens.usage: Categorical slot 3 (yellow). Charts only, assigned by entity in fixed order.

tokens.name: series-4
tokens.usage: Categorical slot 4 (plum). Charts only, assigned by entity in fixed order.

tokens.name: series-5
tokens.usage: Categorical slot 5 (green). Charts only, assigned by entity in fixed order.

tokens.name: series-6
tokens.usage: Categorical slot 6 (magenta). Charts only, assigned by entity in fixed order.

tokens.name: series-7
tokens.usage: Categorical slot 7 (violet). Charts only, assigned by entity in fixed order.

tokens.name: series-8
tokens.usage: Categorical slot 8 (red). Charts only, assigned by entity in fixed order.

tokens.name: neutral-100
tokens.usage: Ordinal neutral ramp step 1 of 5 (light to dark on light, dark to light on dark). Ordered buckets and sequential magnitude.

tokens.name: neutral-200
tokens.usage: Ordinal neutral ramp step 2 of 5 (light to dark on light, dark to light on dark). Ordered buckets and sequential magnitude.

tokens.name: neutral-300
tokens.usage: Ordinal neutral ramp step 3 of 5 (light to dark on light, dark to light on dark). Ordered buckets and sequential magnitude.

tokens.name: neutral-400
tokens.usage: Ordinal neutral ramp step 4 of 5 (light to dark on light, dark to light on dark). Ordered buckets and sequential magnitude.

tokens.name: neutral-500
tokens.usage: Ordinal neutral ramp step 5 of 5 (light to dark on light, dark to light on dark). Ordered buckets and sequential magnitude.

families.mono: "IBM Plex Mono", ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, monospace

groups.name: Text
groups.note: IBM Plex Sans, weights 400/500/600. Tabular figures wherever numbers align or change.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: One hero number per screen: "Left today" on Today, the budget total.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Screen titles and the Today header.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Section titles, event titles on the ticket, sheet titles, lodging name.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Running text, list-row titles, field values.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Button labels, emphasis inside body, row values.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Chip text, segmented options, field labels, status labels.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Row metadata, helper text, tab labels, axis ticks.

groups.name: Codes
groups.note: IBM Plex Mono 400/500 for everything that reads like a ticket: IATA codes, times, countdowns, booking references.

styles.name: code-display
styles.usage: Route on the ticket stub; departure time on the ticket.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Event times in rows, booking references, countdowns.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Departures-board section labels, uppercase, ink-3. One per section.

spacing.note: 8px grid with a 4px half-step for icon-to-label gaps.

tokens.name: space-half
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap, chip inner gap.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Between related controls; row inner gap.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Side gutter, card padding, section header to content.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Between sections on a scrolling screen.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Empty-state padding, large separations.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Tap target for primary controls; FAB height.

radius.note: 4/8/12, sheets 16. No pills except progress ends and dots.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Chips (incl. route chips), badges, bar data-ends, skeletons.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, text fields, segmented control, the ticket card.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: FAB, toasts, empty-state icon square, stat tiles.

tokens.name: radius-sheet
tokens.usage: Top corners of bottom sheets only.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Status dots, progress-track ends, the sheet handle.

shadow.note: Flat. One step only, for things that float.

tokens.name: elevation-1
tokens.usage: Bottom sheets, toasts, the FAB: the only floating things. Dark uses a hairline ring instead of a shadow.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: 2px surface gap, then 2px solid focus.

motion.note: Kept for code; the Design System page has no motion family.

tokens.name: duration-fast
tokens.usage: Toasts, segment thumb, pressed states.

tokens.name: duration-base
tokens.usage: Bottom sheets in and out.

tokens.name: ease-out
tokens.usage: Every transition. Under prefers-reduced-motion: no movement, opacity only.
